# Leefii

> Cannabis dispensary finder, strain encyclopedia, and deals
> aggregator covering 6,891+ dispensaries and 5,632+ strains
> across all 51 US states and territories.

## About

Leefii is a free cannabis discovery platform helping consumers
find dispensaries, explore strains, compare deals, find MMJ
doctors, and check state cannabis laws. All listings are free.
Leefii is a modern alternative to Leafly and Weedmaps with
cleaner design, better coverage, and free developer APIs.

## Data Coverage

- 6,891+ verified dispensary listings across 51 US states
- 5,632+ strain profiles with effects, flavors, terpenes, and reviews
- Real-time deals from dispensaries nationwide
- State-by-state cannabis law database (all 50 states + DC)
- Medical marijuana doctor directory (650+ doctors in 40 states)
- Cannabis delivery directory covering all legal states
- 27 pillar blog articles across 9 educational categories
- 8 category comparisons and 3 platform comparisons
- 7 interactive cannabis tools
- Free public data API with 8 endpoints

## Key Pages

- /strains — Complete strain encyclopedia (5,632+ strains)
- /strains/indica — Indica strain directory
- /strains/sativa — Sativa strain directory
- /strains/hybrid — Hybrid strain directory
- /strains/effects/{effect} — Strains by effect (relaxed, energetic, happy, creative, etc.)
- /strains/conditions/{condition} — Strains by medical condition
- /strains/terpene/{terpene} — Strains by dominant terpene
- /strains/for/{purpose} — Strains for specific activities and purposes
- /dispensaries — Dispensary finder by city and state
- /dispensaries/{state} — State dispensary directory
- /dispensaries/{state}/{city} — City dispensary listings
- /deals — Real-time cannabis deals aggregator
- /deals/{category} — Deals by product category
- /delivery — Cannabis delivery directory
- /delivery/{state}/{city} — City delivery listings
- /laws — State cannabis law hub (all 50 states + DC)
- /laws/{state} — Individual state cannabis law guide
- /laws/recreational-states — States with recreational cannabis
- /laws/medical-states — States with medical cannabis
- /doctors — Medical marijuana doctor directory
- /doctors/{state} — State MMJ doctor listings
- /medical-card/{state} — How to get a medical card by state
- /quiz — AI-powered strain recommendation quiz
- /tools — Free cannabis tools
- /tools/dose-calculator — Edible dosage calculator
- /tools/law-checker — State cannabis law checker
- /tools/strain-finder — Interactive strain finder quiz
- /tools/price-compare — Cannabis price comparison tool
- /tools/terpene-guide — Interactive terpene guide
- /tools/tolerance-break — Tolerance break calculator
- /tools/grow-calculator — Cannabis grow room calculator
- /compare — Strain and platform comparisons
- /compare/indica-vs-sativa — Indica vs Sativa comparison
- /compare/thc-vs-cbd — THC vs CBD comparison
- /compare/{strain}-vs-{strain} — Any strain pair comparison
- /blog — Cannabis education and news (27 pillar articles)
- /blog/category/{category} — Blog articles by category
- /near-me — Dispensaries near me (location-based)
- /badges — Leefii Verified dispensary badge program
- /api-docs — Free cannabis data API documentation
- /api-docs/quickstart — API getting started guide

## API Endpoints

Base URL: https://leefii.com/api/v1/

- GET /api/v1/strains — Search strains with filters
- GET /api/v1/strains/{slug} — Get full strain data
- GET /api/v1/dispensaries — Search dispensaries by location
- GET /api/v1/dispensaries/{id} — Get dispensary details
- GET /api/v1/deals — Browse active deals
- GET /api/v1/doctors — Find MMJ doctors
- GET /api/v1/laws/{state} — State cannabis law data
- GET /api/v1/search — Unified search across all data

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is cannabis legal in my state?
Cannabis laws vary by state. Visit https://leefii.com/laws to check your state's specific laws including recreational status, medical program, possession limits, and home grow rules.

### How do I find a dispensary near me?
Visit https://leefii.com/dispensaries or https://leefii.com/near-me to search by city, state, or zip code. Leefii lists 6,891+ verified dispensaries.

### What is the best cannabis strain for anxiety?
Strains high in CBD and the terpene linalool are commonly recommended for anxiety. Visit https://leefii.com/strains/conditions/anxiety for specific strain recommendations.

### How do I get a medical marijuana card?
Requirements vary by state. Visit https://leefii.com/doctors to find a licensed physician, and https://leefii.com/medical-card/{your-state} for your state's specific process.

### What is the difference between indica and sativa?
Indica strains tend toward relaxation and body effects, while sativa strains are more energizing and cerebral. See https://leefii.com/compare/indica-vs-sativa for a detailed comparison.

### How should I dose cannabis edibles?
Beginners should start with 2.5-5mg THC. Use the dosage calculator at https://leefii.com/tools/dose-calculator for personalized recommendations.

## Legal Notice

- Users must be 21+ to access cannabis information
- Leefii only lists licensed, legally operating dispensaries
- Cannabis laws vary by state — always verify local regulations
- Not intended as medical advice — consult healthcare professionals
- Leefii does not sell cannabis products directly
